title: An Unusual Patient
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Tessa needs medicine and food to treat the captive wolf spider.

About

Given byTessa Reed
Level22
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points2

What you need

  • Spider Friend Medicine Case ×1
  • Boar Meat ×4

Steps

  1. Talk to Tessa Reed to get the quest.
  2. Ask the Dark Witch about the wound inside Dark Witch Hut
  3. Defeat Cale Mott inside Supply Cellar
    Give the medicine case to the Dark Witch - Spider Friend Medicine Case inside Dark Witch Hut
  4. Give Tessa 4 raw boar meat (4) - Boar Meat at 886, 60
  5. Ask Tessa how the spider is doing at 886, 60

Rewards

Reward
Gold400
Character XP20,000
Quest points2

What Tessa Reed says

Dark Witch: Wire cuts fester under silk. I can make a salve, but Cale Mott stole my medicine case. You'll find him in the Supply Cellar north of the Dark Witch's hut.

Dark Witch: Defeat Cale and bring the sealed case back to me. Leave the bottles closed.

Dark Witch: The seals are intact. Good. Give me a moment to mix this.

Dark Witch: There. Tell Tessa to clean the wound, rub in the salve, and bind the leg loosely. Take her four portions of raw boar meat as well. The spider needs to eat.

Tessa Reed: Four portions. That should keep her fed while the leg heals. I'll follow the Witch's instructions now. Stay a moment.

Tessa Reed: I've rubbed the salve into the cut and wrapped it as she said. The spider took the meat from my tongs. That's the first proper meal she's had in days.

Tessa Reed: She can rest now. I'll keep the wound clean while she recovers.

Handing it in

"She can rest now. I'll keep the wound clean while she recovers."

An Unusual Patient
